title: Dining-Out Spend Creep
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=firefly:txn
| where match(category,"(?i)restaurants|takeaway|coffee|dining")
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(abs(amount)) as spend by _time
| streamstats window=4 current=f avg(spend) as baseline
| where baseline>0 AND spend>baseline*1.3
| sort - spend
description: Tracks whether restaurant, takeaway, and coffee spending has quietly crept above the recent norm without you consciously noticing.
value: Lifestyle inflation usually arrives one latte and convenience meal at a time; this alert makes the creep visible before the statement does.
implementation: Tag dining and coffee categories in your ledger export; review weekly spend against the rolling baseline.
visualization: Line chart of weekly dining spend versus four-week baseline.
grandmaExplanation: It maps when your eating-out and coffee spending has quietly drifted above what has been normal lately.
